summary.pack_description:
Get ready to experience the excitement and anticipation of the upcoming NHL season like never before with our Preseason Starter Pack! Whether you're a die-hard hockey fan, an avid collector, or just looking for a thrilling way to connect with your favorite teams and players, this pack is a great way to kick off your collection or move you closer to completing your first sets. 

Featuring every set released so far in Series 1 and many of the top stars of the game with awe-inspiring plays, career milestones, and Stanley Cup chasing highlights from Connor McDavid, Linus Ullmark, Dylan Larkin, Mark Stone, Matty Beniers, Jack Hughes and more! 

Each pack contains 3 Base highlights, plus 2 mystery highlights that could be from Making the Mark, The Hunt for Stanley 2023, Opening Ice, or Base sets.

release.name: Preseason Starter Pack
release.description:
Sale Starts: Friday, Sep 22 at 11AM ET / 8AM PT

Eligibility: Beta users only. Not a beta user? Click here to create your account.

 

Price: $15 USD

# Packs Available: 5000 packs total. 

 

Purchase Limit: Six (6) pack limit per person. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 5

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

  • Three (3) Base highlights (Core #/1500) from the 2022-23 Base set
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 70% Base highlight (Core) from the 2022-23 Base set
    • 30% The Hunt for Stanley 2023 highlight (Limited)
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 80% Base highlight (Core) from the 2022-23 Base set
    • 16% Opening Ice highlight (Rare)
    • 4% Making the Mark highlight (Epic) – includes new career and season-defining highlights from Claude Giroux, Phil Kessel, and Joe Pavelski

 

Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be made via registered payment processor MoonPay where available; where not available, payments will be processed via Stripe. Purchases via cryptocurrency and ACH transfers into your NHL Breakaway account are coming later in 2023.

 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights will be eligible to be sold to other collectors on the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace later in 2023.

 

Transferability: Packs and highlights will be eligible to be traded with or gifted to other NHL Breakaway users later in 2023.

 

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Full Highlights List
  • The Hunt for Stanley 2023, Series 1 - Preview
  • Opening Ice, Series 1 - Preview
  • Base, Series 1 - Preview (Expansion) | Preview (Original)
  • Making the Mark, Series 1 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 1 highlights will only be distributed during Series 1, which ends ~September 2024. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

summary.name: The Hunt for Stanley 2023
summary.description: The Stanley Cup Playoffs are the most grueling and intense postseason in all of sports, and they are a true test of a team's skill, endurance, and mental toughness. The excitement of the playoffs is palpable, with every game feeling like a do-or-die battle for survival. The physicality of the games is ramped up, and every player knows that they have to bring their A-game if they want to advance to the next round. The grind of the playoffs is intense, with teams playing every other night for weeks on end. Injuries can pile up, and exhaustion can set in, but the desire to win the ultimate prize keeps players pushing themselves to their limits. It's a thrilling and exhausting experience that only the best teams are able to survive and emerge victorious.

summary.name: Opening Ice
summary.description: Get ready to witness the NHL’s rising stars like never before with Opening Ice. This set features 20 heart-pounding highlights from players who have notched their first career goal in the 2021-22 and 2022-23 seasons.

summary.name: Making the Mark
summary.description: Making the Mark set celebrates record-setting and career accomplishments of the recent season – moments that have the opportunity to transcend the game and become landmarks in the annals of NHL history.
